# jtt config remove

Forget a project's settings.

![jtt config remove WEB, then jtt config show](gifs/config-remove.gif)

```console
$ jtt config remove WEB
$ jtt config show
```

Nothing changes in Jira. When the removed project was the default, the first remaining project
by key becomes the default.
